summary:
Implementation plan for fixing all 6 critical vulnerabilities and migrating fee data to relational tables:
1. Online payment verification & route auth hardening (prevent unauthorized fee marking)
2. Safe migration of fee ledger from madrasas.registration_no JSON blob to relational tables (fee_types, fee_structures, student_fees, fee_payments) with fallback compatibility
3. Atomic receipt number generation (eliminating race condition duplicates)
4. Removal of auto-super_admin assignment for unassigned users
5. Elimination of cross-tenant student fee leakage in generateMonthlyFees
6. Fixing splice off-by-one bug in deleteFee
